scope: Original mounted CharacterHUD with actual local Friendly character/score/rules providers
restored: Original source host activation and CanvasGroup alpha/blocksRaycasts; interactable is retained
Fresh binding resets health/stamina cached ratios to -1, kills target tweens and snaps to the initial current ratios
Reset clears the binding/profile URL, stops pending pip coroutine and hides the optional profile button without resetting cached ratios or killing running target tweens
Health/maxHealth and stamina/100, original gradient objects and stamina <= 0 flash condition
Changed non-initial ratios enqueue scaled .35-second OutQuad DOAnchorMax only when timeScale == 1; raw gradient/flash updates still occur when a new tween is deferred
Overlapping anchor tweens are retained, capture getters at startup, continue for inactive targets and do not startup for scaled delta strictly between -1e-6 and +1e-6
Pips update once through the original one-WaitUntil coroutine using effective rounds and signed-byte win counts
Original name, exact http/https prefix policy, optional externally owned URL and underline/animation/button behavior
limits: The original component has no Update method. For the local host, an explicitly documented per-render polling bridge detects changed final vitality values; NotifyHealthChanged/NotifyStaminaChanged/NotifyConfigApplied are available for an authoritative network event bridge.
Fusion registration/authority ordering and cross-platform Render/tween scheduling parity have not been demonstrated by an original APK replay.
The oracle observes original calls at engine boundaries; gradient evaluation itself uses engine shims during the isolated comparison, not a running Android Unity renderer.
The numeric oracle uses denormals-enabled Mathf.Epsilon. The actual component calls its matching Unity Mathf.Approximately so the engine supplies platform epsilon at runtime.
Ranked badges require authoritative rank context; no ranked data is fabricated. Friendly uses the source game-mode branch without a badge.
No profile URL is invented for the local rigs. A supplied source-owned URL is only opened by the runtime user pressing its original button.
These checks establish the covered callback decisions and lifecycle outputs, not complete APK behavior or visual/trajectory equivalence.
